selection: Publicly linked downloadable scans with verified page and person alignment; all York-labeled people retained on each selected page. Availability-selected, not a random population sample.

pre_inference_label_flags.finding: Published ages appear to disagree with the scan; the full source including birth-year columns supports different readings. Published labels are retained.
Possible source-versus-label reading difference. This is unresolved, not an adjudicated correction. Published label retained.

excluded_candidates.reason: A published person has a different physical row number on the scan; unresolved pairing.
A published person has a different physical row number, duplicating another reference row; unresolved pairing.
No York rows matched the printed page key.
Additional verified page not selected; enough people and writers already selected before inference.
Additional verified page not selected; enough people and writers already selected before inference.

image_review: All new-page panels visually inspected before inference; source headers and sampled physical row identities checked. This verifies pairing and geometry, not every reference transcription.
crop_limitations: Bowed columns can include adjacent gridlines or checkbox marks. Ink crossing a printed row rule can enter the neighboring crop.
Text extending beyond a printed field can be clipped, including some Robertson occupations around lines 40-44 and Adams occupations.
A ten-row panel can start mid-household. Names remain literal model predictions and are not scored; no surname reconstruction is claimed.
The development source partly clips the final physical row.
scoring: Primary agreement keeps the published reference values unchanged. These notes do not create corrected gold labels or adjusted accuracy.
